meta.title: Japanese to English Voice Translator | IQ Translate
meta.description: Translate Japanese to English by voice or text: speak or paste kanji and kana, read and hear the English at once, reply in Japanese. Free, no sign-up.
meta.ogDescription: Speak or paste Japanese and get the English meaning in seconds, spoken or written. Reply in English and it goes back in Japanese.

hero.title: Japanese to English translator
hero.description: Japanese mixes three writing systems and puts the verb last, which makes a partial reading useless. Record or paste it and read the whole English sentence, then reply in English and send it back in Japanese.
hero.mockFromPhrase: すみません、これはいくらですか？
hero.mockToPhrase: Excuse me, how much is this?

faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating Japanese into English.

items.q: Do I need a Japanese keyboard?
items.a: No. Speak the sentence or paste the text you received; kanji, hiragana and katakana all come through as written.
Yes. Record it and the English appears a couple of seconds after the speaker finishes.
The register of the sentence is carried into the English, so a keigo request does not come out sounding like an order.
Yes, your reply is translated into Japanese in the same conversation and can be read aloud.
Yes, one history per language pair. Even without signing in, this browser is remembered. Clear a pair's history anytime with the trash button above the chat.
Yes. The service is free for everyone — no subscription and no quota. Sign in with email, Google or Apple only if you want your history attached to an account instead of this browser.
